name: johnny-monkey
description: Educational platform with database backup integration

scripts.git:commit: bash scripts/backup-manager.sh create && git add . && git commit -m "Auto-backup: $(date)"
scripts.build: npm install && cd server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && cd ../client && npm install && npm install --save-dev @types/file-saver && npm run build && cd ../server && rm -rf client-build && cp -r ../client/build ./client-build && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm install --save-dev @types/file-saver && npm run build
